name: Out of the holding block
brief: Taken on the trail and locked up, the kit bagged and gone. Get it back, and get out the front door.

start.reads: the last cell of the east wing, its door left on the latch: the operative wakes on its floor, bare-handed

kit.reads: the kit, bagged and tagged on the processing desk: the dart gun, the handgun and the knife

exit.reads: the sally port: the front door out of the block

watchers.reads: the turnkey: the east corridor walked end to end past the cells, a look round at each end; its back to a cell for most of a round, the routine a prisoner reads
the desk sergeant: across the sally port and back, a look round at each wall; the front door is crossed behind him

laws.reads: the holding block's (gameworld/level-kinds.js `holding`): the straight way out is seen; a way out unseen by the round alone (the route search, bare hands: no takedown); the kit is on a way out (a way to it unseen, and from it to the door); so no way out needs a kill
